result.summary: Found 4 visual issues: critically low contrast on the promo banner making it unreadable, the bottom restaurant card clipped behind the tab bar, truncated carousel text, and blurry thumbnails.

issues.description: Promo banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout' is white on very light mint green and is nearly unreadable due to extremely low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color or darken the banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements for readability

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card with pizza image and -20% badge is abruptly cut off and hidden behind the bottom tab bar, with no restaurant name, rating or metadata visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so cards scroll fully above the tab bar and are not obscured

issues.description: Third item in 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis, and far-right category chip is half cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal list has end padding and restaurant names truncate with ellipsis instead of mid-character clipping

issues.description: Restaurant thumbnail images in 'Fastest near you' appear blurry and low-resolution, especially burger and right-side dish.
issues.suggestion: Replace with higher-resolution assets or ensure images finish loading instead of showing blurred placeholders
